request: Test that concurrent purchases never sell more than available capacity.

defects.description: The availability result survives after its mutex is released, so concurrent callers count sales from stale checks and sold exceeds capacity.
defects.why_missed: The suite checks only sequential purchases; it does not hold concurrent buyers between availability checks and decrements.

defects.description: Refund adds returned units without enforcing the inventory ceiling, allowing stock to exceed its configured capacity.
defects.why_missed: The happy suite exercises purchases only and never calls Refund with an amount that pushes stored stock above its limit.

traps.description: Stock() deliberately reports zero when the internal remainder is negative, so its public value never goes negative.
